name_reason: Follows convention fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The '10' is spell_id 0x10 (a meaningful game-domain spell ID in range 0x00-0x23), NOT an address residue (function lives at 0x22153, not 0x10). 'variant_b' descriptor correctly classifies it within the heal/buff variant-B family (ids 0xD-0x10) that dispatch via fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast. Consistent with sibling names fd2_cast_spell_0d/0e/0f_variant_b. Name accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Spell dispatch handler for spell_id 0x10 (variant-B heal/buff family): plays status-effect SFX, plays a slide pre-cast effect, then delegates to the variant-B heal dispatch worker.
logic_summary: Stack-check prologue (__CHK 0x14). Calls fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(data_fd2_audio_status_effect_sfx_handle_ptr, 0xB, 1) to play status-effect SFX id 0xB once; calls fd2_play_variant_b_slide_pre_effect(6, 6) for the slide pre-cast visual; then tail-jumps (no explicit RET; JMP 0x21B0B into the shared tail of fd2_cast_spell_0d_variant_b @ 0x21AD9) which performs fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast(caster, 0x10, n_tgt, tgt_arr). Differs from siblings only by the slide pre-effect params {6,6} and the spell_id literal 0x10. Registered in the spell dispatch table @ 0x51D01 at two slots: entry 0x10 (primary, +0x40) and entry 0x18 (duplicate, +0x60) -- the only variant-B entry with a dual mapping.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_10_variant_b(uint32 caster, uint32 n_tgt, uint8 *tgt_arr)

params.reason: Clear descriptive name matching all sibling handlers in spell.c; no address residue. Both the src form 'caster' and the Ghidra form 'caster_unit_id' accurately denote the casting unit.

params.semantics: Number of targets; passed through to fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast. (Live Ghidra name: num_targets.)
params.reason: Descriptive name consistent across the spell-handler family; no address residue. Accurately denotes the target count.

params.reason: Descriptive name consistent with sibling handlers; no address residue. Accurately denotes the target id array pointer.

returns.semantics: No return value. Function exits via JMP into the shared tail (fd2_dispatch_variant_b_cast then RET); the decompiler models this as a void cdecl with a trailing return.

The family header (lines 120-124) covered shared behavior but the per-entry distinguishing facts (slide params {6,6}, the unique dual dispatch-table mapping at slots 0x10 and 0x18) were undocumented.
